description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. R. Ganeshan as a member of the Colombo Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in the Colombo Municipal Council due to the death of a member, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the procedural steps for nominating a new member (Rasaiya Ganeshan) and the declaration by the Returning Officer. The content is specifically about electoral processes and filling elected positions in local government, making it a clear fit for the Elections category (Type 7).
